resources.string: Melisma reads the media session your music app publishes — track, artist, album, duration and the live playhead — so it can line lyrics up with the song. Android puts that behind “notification access”.\n\nNothing is uploaded except the track title and artist, and only to look up lyrics.
Start a song in Spotify (or any player) and it will show up here.
No lyrics found for this track
Keep your eyes on the road
The words move with the song, which makes them easy to glance at and easy to stare at. Glance. Nothing on this screen needs an answer while you are driving, and the buttons are the car’s own.
Start a song and the words follow it.
Nobody has these words. The app will look again next time it plays.
There is nothing to follow along with, so this screen stays out of the way. The full text is on your phone.
Words already looked up are still shown; new ones need a signal.
Melisma reads what is playing through notification access, and that can only be granted on the phone.
